name: Oftalmo LENS
description: Eyeglass management system for patient and prescription registration, lens fabrication tracking, and stock control, with a dashboard for historical metrics and role-based access with full traceability over sensitive health data.
full_description: Overview

Eyeglass Management System for patient and prescription registration, featuring automatic optical transposition, eyeglass fabrication status tracking, frame and lens stock control, pickup scheduling for patient visits, and a dashboard with historical metrics for data analytics.
Architecture

Decoupled client-server architecture: a layered backend (Controller-Service-Repository) built with Prisma, including a dedicated mapping layer that transforms entities into DTOs before exposing them, plus cross-cutting middleware for role-based authorization and centralized error handling. On the frontend, React Router drives data fetching and mutations via loaders and actions, backed by a dedicated API layer for external calls.
Security

Role-based authentication and authorization, following the Principle of Least Privilege, with encryption of sensitive health data and an audit trail for tracking access to patient records, in compliance with national healthcare regulations.

name: MEGA Manager
description: Bar management system for order entry, sales, and payment processing, along with cash register control, stock, product, and provider management. Includes a dashboard for sales metrics and role-based access with full traceability over financial transactions.
full_description: Overview

Bar Management System for order entry, sales and payment processing. Cash register control (opening, closing, and cash movements) works alongside stock, product, and provider management, along with account records. A dashboard with sales metrics, plus a notification and alerting system for operational inconsistencies. The whole system follows a responsive design, built around staff taking orders directly from their phones at the table.
Architecture

Migrated from a server-side rendered MVC architecture to a decoupled client-server architecture, with a layered backend (Controller-Service-Repository) and a PostgreSQL database managed through TypeORM, plus cross-cutting middleware for role-based authorization and centralized error handling. On the frontend, React Router drives data fetching and mutations via loaders and actions.
Security & Traceability
Role-based authentication and authorization, following the Principle of Least Privilege, with an audit trail for tracking financial transactions.

name: Sales Manager
description: Sales management system for a bar, covering order and sale registration, product administration, and sales summaries by revenue or by units sold.
full_description: Overview

Sales Management System for a bar, allowing staff to register orders and sales, manage products, and view sales summaries by revenue or units sold, filtered by a custom date range. Includes a real-time filter for product selection when taking orders.
Architecture

Server-side rendered MVC architecture, with routing handled through Spring Web MVC and Hibernate/JPA managing data persistence. Jakarta Validation enforces data integrity at the form level, and navigation and page transitions are driven by redirects.

name: Sofia — Tienda de ropa
subtitle: Academic Project
description: Institutional catalog site for a women's clothing store, with category navigation and a registration form.
full_description: Overview
Frontend project for a women's clothing store, featuring a product catalog with category filtering, individual product detail pages, login and registration interfaces, and responsive design.
Architecture

Client-side rendered frontend, with responsive design. Originally connected to a backend hosted on Heroku; product data is now served from a static JSON file after Heroku discontinued its free tier, since the project is presentational and not intended to be a fully functional store.

name: El Vigía — Hostel
subtitle: Academic Project
description: Institutional website for a mountain hostel, presenting its facilities and available outdoor activities.
full_description: Overview
Frontend project for a mountain hostel, presenting general information about the property, facilities, and services, with a dedicated contact section and with responsive design across devices.
Architecture
Multi-page site with client-side navigation between static pages. The contact form performs client-side validation with a simulated submission confirmation.
